Its Li-rich, phosphate chemistry should also limit reactivity with garnet Li and Zr at the contact.

Li4P2O7 is a wide-gap, electronically insulating, Li-rich lithium pyrophosphate. It is the closest available analogue to the Li3PO4 interlayer idea, since it keeps the phosphate chemistry that is compatible with garnet LLZO and LiCoO2. Its high Li content should keep a Li-ion pathway open, and the P5+ centers should resist reduction by garnet Li and Zr at the contact.
